values.note: DNR rate table, Tawas Point Campground: modern camping 20/30-amp rate $45 a night; no separate 50-amp or full-hookup rate is listed. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to all state park and forest campgrounds, on top of the camping fee.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/camping-and-lodging-rates-and-operating-dates (Tawas Point / Tawas Point Campground: Modern camping 20/30 AMP rate $45) + https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tawaspoint ('A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tawaspoint ('All sites include 30-amp electrical service - with 50-amp service available on 38 sites') + midnrreservations.com resources (every campsite 'Electric and Water Hookups: Electric Only', 'Sewer Hookup: No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 189 campsites (plus 20 overflow sites on the booking site), all electric, 38 with 50-amp. Allowed rigs: 4 sites to 50 ft, 158 to 40 ft, 24 to 30 ft, 3 only to 20 ft. 14 pull-throughs. 8 sites tagged lake or beach on the booking site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/tawaspoint ('Number of sites: 189'; 'Some sites with water views, pull-through access or ADA accessibility are available') + midnrreservations.com resources (allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to N'', 'Pull Through: Yes' on 14, 'Adjacent To: Lake/Beach' on 8), read 2026-10-22

note: Campground on a sandy point extending into Lake Huron. At least a few sites are directly on the lake. --AWH Modern campground on the Tawas Bay side of the Tawas Point sand spit, rebuilt and reopened ~2023, with a designated swimming beach; lighthouse tours in summer. --Claude
